title: Discord Bot
description: A Discord Bot source node that receives messages from channels and DMs via the Discord Gateway.
Supports text messages and media attachments (images, audio, video, documents).
Each message type is routed to the appropriate pipeline lane.
Pipeline responses are automatically sent back as replies to the originating channel or thread.
Supports message content intent, attachment downloading, reply threading, and long-message chunking.

discord.botToken.title: Bot Token
discord.botToken.description: Discord bot token from the Developer Portal (keep this secret - do not share)

discord.guildIds.title: Server IDs (Guild IDs)
discord.guildIds.description: List of Discord server IDs to listen to. Leave empty to listen to all servers the bot is in.

discord.channelIds.title: Channel IDs
discord.channelIds.description: List of channel IDs to listen to. Leave empty to listen to all channels.

discord.ignoreBots.title: Ignore Bot Messages
discord.ignoreBots.description: If true (default), messages from other bots are ignored to prevent loops.

discord.requireMention.title: Require @Mention
discord.requireMention.description: If true, the bot only responds when explicitly @mentioned. If false, responds to all messages.

discord.replyMode.title: Reply Mode
discord.replyMode.description: How the bot sends answers: 'channel' (post as normal message), 'reply' (reply to the message), or 'thread' (post in a thread).

discord.showTyping.title: Show Typing Indicator
discord.showTyping.description: If true, show a typing indicator while processing the pipeline.

discord.maxAttachmentBytes.title: Max Attachment Size (bytes)
discord.maxAttachmentBytes.description: Maximum size of attachments to download. Larger files are skipped. Default 25 MB.

discord.sendResponses.title: Send Responses
discord.sendResponses.description: If true, the bot sends pipeline answers back to Discord. If false, only processes messages.
